messages.subject: error with extractModelSummaries
messages.body_plain:
When trying to extract model summaries for EFA models (R 3.1.2, Mplus 7.3) the following error messages occurred:

> mySummaries <- extractModelSummaries("efa.out")
Error in seq.default(factorLB, factorUB) :
  'from' cannot be NA, NaN or infinite
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In extractSummaries_1file(readfile, outfiles[i], inp) :
  NAs introduced by coercion
2: In extractSummaries_1file(readfile, outfiles[i], inp) :
  NAs introduced by coercion

Does someone know how to solve this problem?
